constraint_types.interpretation: Upper bound on the QP translational velocity command; not a proof about measured physical speed.

constraint_policy.status: Software admission/design ranges, not validated RB-Y1 velocity, acceleration, braking, clearance, or safety ratings.
constraint_policy.executor_rule: LLM constraints can tighten applicable limits. The executor must also impose the current model limits, collision checks, sensor/TF freshness and stop policy; these cannot be removed by a task specification. A valid specification is not execution or safety validation.
